messages:
Asha: Heads-up — drafting a short customer-facing runbook we can share during onboarding and renewal health checks. Goal: give clear prescriptive guidance on prefill/prefetch, batching defaults, and streaming fallbacks plus a quick feedback capture flow for renewal risk detection. Can folks skim and add practical tips?

Tom: +1. Short and prescriptive is good. For prefill: recommend a small static cache for top-5 intents, and a short warmup sequence on go-live. Share config snippet to copy.

Tom: ```json
{
  "prefetch": {
    "enabled": true,
    "top_n_intents": 5,
    "timeout_ms": 250
  },
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_size": 8,
    "latency_slo_ms": 150
  },
  "streaming_fallback": {
    "enable_streaming": true,
    "fallback_on_timeout_ms": 300
  }
}
```

Miguel: A few SRE notes — please call out safe defaults for small customers (e.g., max_batch_size 4) and an escalation path if tail latency spikes. Also include example alerts: p95 > 500ms for 5m, error rate > 1% for 10m.

Priya: For renewal-risk capture: embed a 3-question feedback ping after key flows (only if client opts-in). Suggested questions (short): 1) "Did this feel fast enough?" (Y/N), 2) "Any incorrect/low-quality responses?" (short text), 3) "Would you consider expanding usage?" (Yes/Maybe/No). Add a simple webhook example to post answers to CS queue.

Asha: Love the questions. Can we standardize the wording so we can A/B later? Maybe short and less technical. Example: "Was this helpful?" instead of latencies.

Tom: Agreed — keep UX copy minimal. Also add a fallback pattern: if streaming connectivity fails, switch to non-streaming endpoint and show a brief loader with reason "Connection issues — fetching full response". Example pseudo-flow below.

Tom: ```text
Client -> request (stream=true)
if stream connection error -> route to /generate (sync) with same prompt, mark event: streaming_fallback=true
notify client: "Taking a moment to fetch the full answer"
log: fallback_reason, latency_before_fallback, customer_id
```

Miguel: Ops checklist additions:
- Pre-deploy warmup: run 100 short prompts through warm path (script attached)
- Monitor KV cache hit rate (target > 60% first 24h for prefill)
- Alert playbook: rollback batching increase, reduce batch size to 2, enable dedicated cache-only nodes

Priya: For CS intake: add a single-button in Console to export the last 7 days of feedback + sample failing prompts (redact PII). That makes handoff to Product/ML much faster.

OnboardBot: [automated] New runbook draft created by Asha. Checklist: share with account SME, add to onboarding template, link to onboarding-playbook.

Asha: Quick propose structure for the runbook we can paste into onboarding:
1) TL;DR (1-2 lines)
2) Quick config copy (prefill/batch/stream defaults)
3) Monitoring & alerts (what to watch)
4) Troubleshooting steps (fallbacks, rollback knobs)
5) Feedback capture & renewal flags (what to ask, when to escalate)
6) Contact & escalation (CSM, SRE, Solutions engineer)

Tom: I'll add the config copy + example code snippets to a shared doc.

Miguel: I'll draft the alert rules and warmup script gist. Ping me for test customers.

Priya: I'll add the short feedback survey copy and webhook sample, plus the CSV template for exports.

Asha: Great. One more thing — include guidance for renewals scoring: if feedback negative AND usage drop > 20% over rolling 14 days OR repeated streaming fallbacks >3 in 7 days -> flag as medium-high renewal risk and trigger 1:1 outreach.

Tom: Noted. We'll surface that as a tag in the CS dashboard.

Asha: Thanks all — I'll stitch this into the runbook and drop a PR into the onboarding repo later today. :pray:

Miguel: Thanks — will review the PR this afternoon.

Priya: Happy to review copy for customer-facing tone. :smile:
